scope: Migration 405 signed worker context and execution-role acceptance
container_network: loopback-only published port; runner makes no external requests

checks.description: valid exact worker grant signs tenant/location/actor and operation
tampered worker context payload fails HMAC validation
worker role cannot read credentials or the HMAC signing key
signed worker context expires at transaction end
signed worker context cannot be replayed in a later transaction
cross-location and non-exact resource/action grants fail closed
a denied setter clears an earlier signed scope in the transaction
shared runtime login cannot execute or assume worker execution role
worker grant lock serializes revocation with an active context
owner transfer invalidates a still-active worker grant

limitations: Only the worker context migration ran against a minimal synthetic prior-schema fixture.
No application-table RLS policy, handler integration, worker deployment, provider, candidate, or legacy database was changed or exercised.
